zh: 我每周六打扫房子。
en: I {clean} the house every Saturday.

zh: 他修好了漏水的水龙头。
en: He {fixed|repaired} the leaking tap.

zh: 她正在熨衬衫。
en: She is {ironing} a shirt.

zh: 你能把垃圾桶倒空吗？
en: Could you {empty} the bin?

zh: 我们上个月搬进了新公寓。
en: We {moved} into a new flat last month.

zh: 出门的时候把门锁上。
en: {Lock} the door when you leave.

zh: 他给植物浇了水。
en: He {watered} the plants.

zh: 我把洗好的衣服挂在外面晾干。
en: I {hung} the washing outside to dry.

zh: 她用吸尘器吸了地毯。
en: She {vacuumed} the carpet.

zh: 我们把墙刷成了白色。
en: We {painted} the walls white.

zh: 他修剪了草坪。
en: He {mowed|cut} the lawn.

zh: 水管昨晚爆了。
en: The pipe {burst} last night.

zh: 我把床单叠好了。
en: I {folded} the sheets.

zh: 她擦了桌子。
en: She {wiped|cleaned} the table.

zh: 灯泡需要更换了。
en: The light bulb needs to be {replaced|changed}.

zh: 我们租这套房子两年了。
en: We have {rented} this house for two years.

zh: 他自己把书架组装好了。
en: He {assembled|built} the bookshelf himself.

zh: 我扫了厨房的地。
en: I {swept} the kitchen floor.

zh: 她拉上了窗帘。
en: She {closed|drew|shut} the curtains.

zh: 房东涨了房租。
en: The landlord {raised|increased} the rent.

zh: 我今天早上洗了衣服。
en: I {did} the washing this morning.

zh: 我们已经把房子挂牌出售了。
en: We've {listed} our house for sale.

zh: 我们的暖气坏了。
en: Our heater has {broken|died|stopped working}.

zh: 我们得给房子做隔热。
en: We need to {insulate} the house.

zh: 狗把我的拖鞋咬坏了。
en: The dog {chewed} my slippers.

zh: 我们正在找新房子。
en: We're {looking|searching} for a new place.

zh: 我们家被盗了。
en: Our house was {burgled|broken into|robbed}.

zh: 我们住在一栋老房子里。
en: We {live} in an old house.

zh: 打开窗户透透气。
en: {Open} the window to let some air in.

zh: 浴室的下水道堵了。
en: The bathroom drain is {blocked|clogged}.

zh: 他把碗碟放进了洗碗机。
en: He {loaded|stacked} the dishwasher.

zh: 他把垃圾分了类。
en: He {sorted} the rubbish.

zh: 我们在后院种了一些西红柿。
en: We {planted|grew} some tomatoes in the backyard.

zh: 我每天喂两次猫。
en: I {feed} the cat twice a day.

zh: 我们装了一个新的热泵。
en: We {installed|got|put in} a new heat pump.

zh: 他把草坪上的落叶都耙了。
en: He {raked} the leaves on the lawn.

zh: 房东同意修好热水器。
en: The landlord {agreed} to fix the hot water cylinder.

zh: 他们的房子被洪水淹了。
en: Their house was {flooded}.

zh: 地板会吱吱作响。
en: The floorboards {creak}.

zh: 我把钥匙忘在家里了。
en: I {left} my keys at home.

zh: 他在洗澡。
en: He's {having|taking} a shower.

zh: 我们重新布置了客厅。
en: We {rearranged} the living room.

zh: 我把过期的牛奶倒进了水槽。
en: I {poured} the old milk down the sink.

zh: 我每天晚上十一点睡觉。
en: I {go} to bed at eleven every night.

zh: 我用力把锅刷干净了。
en: I {scrubbed} the pot clean.

zh: 我昨晚把暖气开了一整夜。
en: I {left} the heater on all night.

zh: 我在花园里除草。
en: I'm {weeding} the garden.

zh: 水壶烧开了。
en: The kettle has {boiled}.

zh: 墙上的油漆在剥落。
en: The paint on the wall is {peeling}.

zh: 屋顶在漏水。
en: The roof is {leaking}.

zh: 我们的租约下个月到期。
en: Our lease {ends|expires|finishes|runs out} next month.

zh: 我每周换一次床单。
en: I {change} the sheets once a week.

zh: 他用螺丝把搁板固定在墙上。
en: He {screwed|fixed|attached} the shelf to the wall.

zh: 我整理了一下衣柜。
en: I {tidied|organised|organized|sorted} my wardrobe.

zh: 我们正在装修厨房。
en: We're {renovating|redoing|remodelling|remodeling} the kitchen.

zh: 我们和两个朋友合租这套房子。
en: We {share} this house with two friends.

zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗？
en: Can you help me {carry|take|move} this box upstairs?

zh: 我们把客房改成了书房。
en: We {turned|converted|made} the spare room into an office.

zh: 我们把电视挂到了墙上。
en: We {mounted|hung|put} the TV on the wall.

zh: 我给门上了油，现在不响了。
en: I {oiled} the door and now it doesn't squeak.

zh: 擦台面之前先把抹布拧干。
en: {Wring|Squeeze} the cloth well before you wipe the bench.

zh: 客人来之前，我得用吸尘器把客厅吸一下。
en: I need to {hoover|vacuum} the lounge before the guests arrive.

zh: 出门前把熨斗的插头拔掉。
en: {Unplug} the iron before you go out.

zh: 那间空房间也兼作办公室用。
en: The spare room {doubles} as an office.

zh: 房东负责维护热水器。
en: The landlord is responsible for {maintaining|servicing} the hot water cylinder.

zh: 她当面找室友谈了脏碗不洗的问题。
en: She {confronted|tackled} her flatmate about the dirty dishes.

zh: 我们的市议会回收玻璃和塑料。
en: Our council {recycles} glass and plastic.

zh: 我找新公寓已经找了好几个星期了。
en: I've been {hunting|looking|searching} for a new flat for weeks.

zh: 我去泡一壶新咖啡。
en: I'll {brew|make} a fresh pot of coffee.

zh: 烤面包的烟触发了火警。
en: The smoke from the toast {triggered|set off} the fire alarm.

zh: 我的头撞到了橱柜门上。
en: I {bumped|banged|hit|knocked} my head on the cupboard door.

zh: 我今天早上冲了个澡。
en: I {showered} this morning.

zh: 我打开了前门的锁。
en: I {unlocked} the front door.

zh: 凌晨两点有人在使劲砸门。
en: Someone was {banging|pounding|hammering|knocking} on the door at two in the morning.

zh: 她一边做饭一边哼着小曲。
en: She was {humming} a tune while she cooked.

zh: 我们下个月要搬去惠灵顿。
en: We're {shifting|moving} to Wellington next month.

zh: 我们的公寓朝北，所以阳光很充足。
en: Our flat {faces} north, so it gets lots of sun.

zh: 我的钥匙不见了。
en: My keys have {disappeared|vanished|gone}.

zh: 恒温器会自动调节温度。
en: The thermostat {regulates|controls} the temperature automatically.

zh: 我不小心把我最喜欢的黑T恤漂白了。
en: I accidentally {bleached} my favourite black T-shirt.

zh: 别忘了冲马桶。
en: Don't forget to {flush} the toilet.

zh: 旧电池应该怎么处理？
en: How should I {dispose} of old batteries?

zh: 之前的租客完全没打理花园。
en: The previous tenants completely {neglected|ignored} the garden.

zh: 你能帮我把车上的东西卸下来吗？
en: Can you help me {unload} the car?

zh: 你能把餐桌摆好吗？我们七点吃饭。
en: Can you {lay|set} the table? Dinner's at seven.

zh: 妈妈帮我补好了牛仔裤上的洞。
en: Mum {mended|fixed|patched|repaired} the hole in my jeans.

zh: 我们周六去看那套出租的公寓。
en: We're going to {view|see|inspect} the flat on Saturday.

zh: 家里有点乱，请见谅。
en: Please {excuse|forgive} the mess.

zh: 我周日花了一整天给衣柜断舍离。
en: I spent Sunday {decluttering|sorting out|clearing out|tidying} my wardrobe.

zh: 你洗碗，我来把碗擦干。
en: You wash the dishes and I'll {dry}.

zh: 孩子们都搬出去了，我爸妈打算换个小点的房子。
en: My parents are planning to {downsize} now the kids have moved out.

zh: 现在在奥克兰租房子变得难多了。
en: It's {become|got|gotten} much harder to find a flat in Auckland.

zh: 我的衬衫被钉子刮破了。
en: I {tore|ripped} my shirt on a nail.

zh: 我的牛仔裤被钉子刮破了。
en: I {ripped|tore} my jeans on a nail.

zh: 我昨天把书架上的灰掸了一遍。
en: I {dusted} the bookshelves yesterday.

zh: 她指责我偷吃了她的酸奶。
en: She {accused} me of eating her yoghurt.

zh: 厨房的水龙头一直在滴水。
en: The kitchen tap keeps {dripping}.

zh: 我出国期间想把房间转租出去。
en: I want to {sublet|sublease} my room while I'm overseas.

zh: 有人把一张旧沙发扔在了路边。
en: Someone {dumped|left} an old couch on the side of the road.

zh: 我把热泵设定成早上六点自动开启。
en: I {programmed|set} the heat pump to come on at six in the morning.

zh: 他们因为不交房租被房东赶了出去。
en: They {were evicted|got evicted|were kicked out} for not paying the rent.

zh: 我踮着脚尖走进了宝宝的房间。
en: I {tiptoed|crept} into the baby's room.

zh: 我洗碗的时候不小心把一个碗磕了个缺口。
en: I {chipped} a bowl while I was doing the dishes.

zh: 他正在把皮鞋擦亮。
en: He's {polishing|shining} his shoes.

zh: 当地人说那栋老房子闹鬼。
en: Locals say the old house is {haunted}.

zh: 他气得摔门走了。
en: He {slammed} the door and walked out.

zh: 洗衣机正在甩干。
en: The washing machine is {spinning}.

zh: 木头平台开始腐烂了。
en: The deck is starting to {rot|decay}.

zh: 他正躺在沙发上看电视。
en: He's {lying} on the couch watching TV.

zh: 我的钥匙不翼而飞了！
en: My keys have {vanished|disappeared}!

zh: 亮色的靠垫和灰色的沙发形成了很好的对比。
en: The bright cushions {contrast} nicely with the grey sofa.

zh: 她把包挂在了椅背上。
en: She {hooked|hung} her bag over the back of the chair.

zh: 我们忘了交电费，电力公司把电给停了。
en: We forgot to pay, so the power company {disconnected|cut off} our electricity.

zh: 记得锁门。
en: {Remember} to lock the door.

zh: 邻居整晚都把音乐开得震天响。
en: The neighbours were {blasting|pumping|cranking} music all night.

zh: 我们给卧室贴了墙纸。
en: We {wallpapered} the bedroom.

zh: 水管工把下水道疏通了。
en: The plumber {unblocked|unclogged|cleared} the drain.

zh: 我刚拖过厨房的地。
en: I've just {mopped} the kitchen floor.

zh: 这件夹克是我哥哥的。
en: This jacket {belongs} to my brother.

zh: 他们把旧车库改造成了一间工作室。
en: They {transformed|converted|turned} the old garage into a studio.
